description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange from 28.06.2021 to 04.07.2021
categorisation: This gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for financial compliance with customs regulations, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter. While it names the Director General of Customs, it does so only in his official capacity to issue the regulatory directive and does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would fall under government classifications (Types 1-3).
